title: Gouder Wines
summary: As part of an Ad campaign aimed at messaging “embow your day with Gouder Wine”, I was tasked to create concepts that would go on print ads on several touchpoints.

blocks.body: As part of an Ad campaign aimed at messaging “embow your day with Gouder Wine”, I was tasked to create concepts that would go on print ads on several touchpoints. The project was interesting because of a couple of reasons one being, it’s a dream come true working for a company I grew nearby, and the second being it also represents some of the print design concepts I tend to produce.
